dict.string: Sesame uses your location to sort your saved entries by distance, so the place you're closest to appears at the top of your list.

Sesame uses your location in the background to detect when you arrive at a saved place and notify you with its access code — for example, showing your building code as you reach the front door, even when the app is closed.
Sesame sends you a notification displaying the access code when you arrive at a saved location.
